tools.name: track_parcel
tools.description: Track a SAMOS parcel by tracking number. Returns tracking events, newest first, and local_carrier_tracking_url: a link to track the parcel with the local delivery company (e.g. UPS) once it has reached them. Share that link when the user wants more delivery detail.

tools.name: estimate_shipping_price
tools.description: Estimate the SAMOS price (GBP) to ship a parcel from the UK to a country, or to return a parcel from that country to the UK. Max weight 20 kg, max dimensions 100 cm x 43 cm x 43 cm.

tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: List the countries SAMOS ships to from the UK, with their ISO codes and whether returns from that country are supported.

tools.name: search_help
tools.description: Search the SAMOS help centre (FAQs) for answers about shipping, customs, IOSS, labels, returns and accounts. Returns the best matching questions and answers.

tools.name: estimate_duties
tools.description: Estimate the import duties and taxes the recipient pays on one item shipped from the UK with SAMOS. Provide a product description or HS code. Heavily rate limited: only call when the user asks for a duties/tax estimate.
